description:
[read-only] List the brand’s uploaded music with audio URLs, source, license, attribution, duration, mood/tags and ad-use guidance. A bound key only accesses its brand; brandId can select a brand for an account-wide key. includeArchived also returns archived tracks.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/music/tracks.)

brandId.description: Brand id or personal. Omit to use the key’s bound brand, otherwise the owner’s active brand.

name: music_tracks_list
title: List music tracks
